b2b_hero_h1: Loyalty is not marketing. It is cognitive engineering.
b2b_hero_sub_new: How to retain 90% of guests using the Nobel theory of loss aversion and Zero Friction technology.
b2b_leaky_bucket_h2: Why your current loyalty system doesn't work 100%?
b2b_leaky_bucket_intro: Why do you lose up to 83% of new guests? Classic programs are hopelessly outdated.
b2b_problem_app_desc: 80% of guests refuse to download a new app or fill out long forms at checkout.
b2b_problem_stanford_desc: Stanford scientists proved: if an action requires effort (high friction), the customer won't do it.
b2b_problem_blindspot_desc: Paper stamp cards know nothing about your guests.
b2b_leaky_bucket_fact: Important fact: acquiring a new customer costs 7 times more than retaining an existing one.
b2b_simplicity_intro: We removed all barriers between you and your customer.
b2b_simplicity_tap: Tap & Go: The guest simply taps their phone on an NFC tag or scans a QR code.
b2b_simplicity_recognize: Instant Recognition: The device is recognized in the browser. No SMS codes or registrations.
b2b_simplicity_done: Done: The customer is now in your database, and you've achieved 100% conversion to the loyalty program.
b2b_diagnosis_h2: Diagnosis: Chronic Leakage of Lifetime Value (LTV).
b2b_diagnosis_intro: Most establishments spend huge budgets (CAC) on acquisition, but customers "leak" to competitors after the first visit.
b2b_diagnosis_conclusion: You are not building a business; you are just paying Facebook and Google advertising bills.
b2b_science_sub: Why are traditional loyalty systems (apps and cards) dead? Because they create Neural Friction.
b2b_science_kahneman_text: We don't offer the guest to "save for a gift". We give them an asset (status). Psychologically, losing 100% of the battery charge is twice as painful as the joy of a free coffee.
b2b_science_friction_text: Removing the entry barrier. 0.5 seconds for a "Tap" is faster than taking out a wallet.
b2b_science_reward_text: How variable rewards trigger a dopamine response, making the guest check the battery status again and again.
b2b_tech_sub: No POS integrations. No staff training. Full autonomy.
b2b_tech_melting_text: How the "melting" mechanic works: the longer the pause between visits, the lower the charge.
b2b_tech_wallet_text: Using native smartphone tools instead of third-party apps.
b2b_analytics_bot_text: Real-time notifications to the owner: "Your VIP guest has entered the hall."
b2b_analytics_ai_text: Predicting customer churn before they decide to leave.
b2b_guarantee_text: We are so confident in the scientific base that we take all risks. If in a month you don't see a measurable increase in visit frequency, we refund your investment.
b2b_form_received: We have received your request and will contact you within 24 hours.
